name: live_scene_presentation
description: Host scripts show and play what the ending of the game shows (FadeToCreditsTimerScript): IMod FadeToBlack4sISFX, PlaySound QSTEndTransitionStinger, PlayMusic musDocMitchellHouse, IMod FadeToBlackPermanent, then RIMod FadeToBlack4sISFX. Each script function calls GameState::coop_present. The host sends the five cues (SceneMsg::Present) and the guest applies each one (presentation::apply): its own modifiers end with the permanent fade on, as the host's do.
